## ICompositeRange interface

Explicit bounds for a composite index range seek.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ICompositeRange 
```

## Remarks

Accepted as a `findByIndex` value for composite keys (`t.*.index(["a", "b"])`<!-- -->), queried as `{"a+b": {start, end}}`<!-- -->). Either bound may be omitted (open-ended); each present bound is a tuple of 1..arity elements. `start` is inclusive, `end` is exclusive.
